questions.stem_text:
Silver bromide, AgBr, used in photography, may be prepared from AgNO\_3 and NaBr. Calculate
the weight of each required for producing 93.3 lb of AgBr. (1 lb = 454 g.)

options.A: 50 lbs of NaBr and 85 lbs of AgNO3
options.B: 45 lbs of NaBr and 75 lbs of AgNO3
options.C: 52.7 lbs of NaBr and 84.7 lbs of AgNO3
options.D: 70 lbs of NaBr and 50 lbs of AgNO3
options.E: 40 lbs of NaBr and 90 lbs of AgNO3

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - 52.7 lbs of NaBr and 84.7 lbs of AgNO3

questions.stem_text:
A buffer is made from equal concentrations of a weak acid and its conjugate base. Doubling
the volume of the buffer solution by adding water has what effect on its pH?

options.A: It causes the pH to fluctuate unpredictably.
options.B: It causes the pH to equalize with the water's pH.
options.C: It causes the pH to become extremely basic.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - It causes the pH to fluctuate unpredictably.

questions.stem_text: The molecule with a tetrahedral shape is
The Pauli exclusion principle states that

options.A: no two electrons can occupy separate orbitals
options.B: no two protons can have the same four quantum numbers
options.C: two electrons can share the same quantum number if they are in different orbitals
options.D: no two electrons can have the same four quantum numbers
options.E: no two electrons can pair up if there is an empty orbital available

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - no two electrons can have the same four quantum numbers
